notes.title: December 2 Update - NVidia DLSS / AMD FSR / Other Supersamplers Support
notes.content:
[b]Updated Spaceship build to Unity 2021.2[/b]

[list]
[*] Added Support for Full Screen Upscalers (DLSS, AMD FSR, TemporalAA Upsampling, Contrast-Adaptive Sharpen, and Catmull-Rom)
[*] Added support for Lens Flares
[/list]

Note: NVidia DLSS Support is currently available on Windows builds
